about: A testing framework that runs end-to-end tests on web and mobile apps.

prs.title: A skipped test is reported once when tests are split up
prs.broken: Tests can be split into parts that run on separate machines. Every part reported every skipped test again, so totals added up across parts counted each skip several times.
prs.changed: Each skipped test is now reported by one part only, and how the tests are split stays the same.
prs.matters: Reports from a split test run add up to the real numbers.
